evals.name: confirmation gate fires before any search
evals.prompt: Here's my resume (attached). Find me roles that fit.
evals.expected_output: A search brief table with a Source column built from the resume, followed by at most about 5 numbered questions in one message that ask for work mode, base pay floor and visa sponsorship. No job-board request is made before the user answers.
assertions: Shows a search brief table with a Source column (values like resume / inferred / default / needs you)
Asks for work mode, base pay floor, and visa sponsorship
Asks at most about 5 questions, all in one message
Does not run scripts/probe.py (search or --health) before the user replies
Does not ask about or infer age, gender, race, nationality, religion, or family status
Marks the current employer (Lumenly) as an inferred exclusion to confirm

evals.name: just go — proceeds with labelled defaults
evals.prompt: Here's my resume (attached). Skip the questions and just go — use your best guess.
evals.expected_output: The brief is still shown, with every assumed value labelled default (or inferred), and the skill proceeds in the same reply without waiting: it saves the profile and runs the network check.
assertions: Shows the brief table even though the user asked to skip questions
Every value the user did not provide is labelled default or inferred, not presented as confirmed
Does not stop to ask questions
Saves the profile with scripts/state.py profile save and runs scripts/probe.py --health in the same reply
Does not invent a pay floor or a sponsorship answer: base_pay_floor is null (no floor) and needs_sponsorship is undisclosed unless stated

evals.name: negative trigger — cover letter
evals.prompt: Write a cover letter for the Vercel Design Engineer role: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vercel/jobs/6129441004
evals.expected_output: No search runs. The reply says cover letters are out of scope for job-scout (or routes outreach to ghostwriter if installed) and offers to find more roles instead.
assertions: Runs no job-scout script (no probe.py, no state.py)
Says cover letters are out of scope for job-scout
Does not draft a cover letter as job-scout output

evals.name: chat-only, non-developer user
evals.prompt: I'm a marketing manager in Austin, what's out there?
evals.expected_output: With no resume, the brief is built from the chat (target roles inferred from 'marketing manager', home base Austin from the user). The gate still asks work mode, pay floor and sponsorship. No jargon such as ATS, slug, JSON or API in the questions or brief.
assertions: Builds a brief from the chat message alone; home base Austin has Source you
Still asks for work mode, base pay floor, and visa sponsorship before any search
Does not run scripts/probe.py before the user replies
Uses no jargon (ATS, slug, JSON, API) in the questions or the brief
Mentions honestly that coverage is best for tech and startup employers, if relevant to marketing roles outside tech
